milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and visually observe it. The redstone_block pillar is at spawn-relative [6, 1, 7] (the upper block of the 2-high pillar, placed via /setblock ~6 ~1 ~7). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have clearly located the landmark, and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than passing by coincidentally.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_sandstone causes it to drop as a 'red_sandstone' item that enters the player's inventory. CommonSenseAgent confirmed red_sandstone drops itself without needing silk touch. The player has an iron pickaxe (given via /give) which is more than sufficient. Checking inventory for min_count=1 is the most direct and reliable way to verify the block was actually mined.
